A bird just pulled a worm out of a meerkat's eye.
At first, nothing seems wrong with this meerkat's eye.
But this little yellow bird keeps coming back to the exact same spot.
Hold still. Something's moving in there.
Then it pulls... and pulls... and out comes a parasite far bigger than anyone expected.
Eye worms are real. Flies spread them while sipping tears.
But real ones are thread-thin, under two centimetres. A grub this fat? That viral clip is probably AI.
